title: specht facts
description: The document specht facts writes for --json (0132-F2): what the specification tree holds, with no violation, count or verdict. Within a tool major version it changes only by addition (C-3).

specifications.description: Every Feature specification the check discovers, in discovery order; epic files are not given.

path.description: Relative to the root the tool was given, with / separators; never absolute.

id.description: The qualified Feature id the check reads, such as 0132-F2, or null when the specification has no identity.

specStatus.description: The specification's maturity, read through the manifest's frontmatter key, or null.

status.description: The delivery status, read through the manifest's frontmatter key, or null.

dependsOn.description: The depends-on list as the frontmatter writes it, unresolved; empty when absent.

blocks.description: The blocks list as the frontmatter writes it, unresolved; empty when absent.

children.description: The children list as the frontmatter writes it; empty when absent.

claims.description: Every row of the claims table, in row order, two sharing an id and a withdrawn or superseded one included; empty without a claims section or table. A claim carries no traceability row, scenario or test.

id.description: The row's id as the check reads it, its first cell; empty when the cell is.

text.description: The cell under the Claim header, or null when the table has no such cell.

status.description: The cell under the Status header as written, or null when the table has no such cell.

constraints.description: Every row of the constraints table, in row order; empty without a constraints section or table.

id.description: The row's first cell; empty when the row has none.

text.description: The cell under the Constraint header, or null when the table has no such cell.

rulesOut.description: The cell under the Rules Out header, or null when the table has no such cell.

outOfScope.description: Every row of the out-of-scope table, in row order; empty without an out-of-scope section or a table the parse reads.

number.description: The row's first cell as written, not parsed into a number; empty when the row has none.

item.description: The cell under the Item header, or null when the table has no such cell.

reason.description: The cell under the Exclusion Reason header, or null when the table has no such cell.

openQuestions.description: Every row of the open-questions table, in row order; empty without an open-questions section or a table the parse reads.

id.description: The row's first cell; empty when the row has none.

question.description: The cell under the Question header, or null when the table has no such cell.

blocks.description: The cell under the Blocks header as written, not split into ids, or null when the table has no such cell.

resolution.description: The cell under the Resolution header as written, or null when the table has no such cell.

resolved.description: False when the resolution is null, empty, or its first word, up to the first character that is neither a letter nor a digit, is Open in exact case; true otherwise.

records.description: Every Markdown file directly in the adr, decisions and lessons folders beside the specification, in ordinal order of path; empty when it has none. A record's body is not given.

number.description: The file name's first word, up to the first character that is neither a letter nor a digit, as written; null when the name begins with no such word.

title.description: The frontmatter's title as written; null when the frontmatter is missing or unreadable or its title is absent or not a string.

status.description: For an adr, the first word, as written, of the first line under its Status heading, or null; null for a decision and a lesson.

path.description: Relative to the root the tool was given, with / separators; never absolute.

deltas.description: Every list item and every row of the table of the lessons-and-deltas section, in line order; empty without such a section or with neither.

text.description: A list item's text as the parse gives it, its paragraphs and nested items joined by one space; null for a table row.

cells.description: A table row's cells in column order, as the parse gives them; empty for a list item.

signOff.description: Every row of the sign-off table, in row order; empty without a sign-off section or a table the parse reads.

section.description: The cell under the first sign-off header the manifest names, or null when the table has no such cell.

status.description: The cell under the second sign-off header the manifest names, as written, or null when the table has no such cell.

reviewer.description: The cell under the third sign-off header the manifest names, or null when the table has no such cell.

note.description: The cell under the fourth sign-off header the manifest names, or null when the table has no such cell.
